label: Low-Distress Graduate Male
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education who reports very low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms, and who spends 1–3 hours on the measured activity.
demographic_anchor: Male; graduate degree or above; 1–3 hours on the measured activity.
behavior_markers: Spends 1–3 hours on the measured activity.

label: Higher Loneliness and Distress Profile
summary: This profile is characterized by higher loneliness and elevated depressive and anxiety symptoms relative to the sample. It is anchored to female respondents with graduate-level education or above who report more than five hours of daily screen or device use.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of daily screen or device use.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 (mean 1.66)
Reports elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 1.65)
Reports elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 2.10)
Spends more than 5 hours per day on screen or device use
tone: Reserved and reflective, with a tendency toward worry and low mood; may express social disconnection while remaining high-functioning in educational or professional contexts.

label: Low Distress, Low Loneliness
summary: A female respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low loneliness and low depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate or above; 1–3 hours of daily activity.
